examples.detail: The reconstruction answers or correctly preserves unknown for all fifteen independently checked questions, including scale claims, lip sync, real/digital identity, event identity, audio, reuse, and the opening-to-closing decision relation.
CQ-13, CQ-14, and CQ-15 close the prior audio, reuse-disposition, and conference-identity gaps with current evidence.

Every core knowledge unit has one or more resolvable evidence references; the 19 core units collectively cover the independent audit's consequential visible facts, author claims, carrier conflict, decision-boundary absences, replacement scope, and reuse constraints.
KU-25 covers the source-audio carrier, KU-27 and KU-28 close reuse disposition, and KU-01/KU-03 retain the exact-event qualifier.

The 26 positive author-claim, visual-observation, and system-inference units are either directly evidenced or explicitly bounded; none upgrades a creator assertion, appearance, juxtaposition, classifier candidate, or scoped absence into an independently verified fact.

Mouth motion is not treated as lip-sync proof, the walking participant is not identified as digital, and the closing Ding/Ping classification remains a candidate rather than a definitive sound identity.

All 103 checked knowledge-unit evidence references resolve to the source transcript, shot/frame manifests, targeted captures, OCR rows, or declared audio sources; no checked frame falls outside its unit range.
The SRT/burned-caption conflict is localized to 64.79-68.71 seconds, and the closing sound candidate is scoped to 80-83.220313 seconds.

processDependencyCompleteness.rationale: The source is an edited claims-and-examples video, not a demonstrated executable workflow. The reconstruction explicitly rejects treating 29 technical shot boundaries as a continuous process and preserves backend, real-time, generation, and operational dependencies as unknown.

examples.detail: All nine audited unknown-opportunity groups remain bounded: commercial figures; identity/realtime status; lip-sync and quality tests; industry-first/commercial-usability definitions; replacement scale; access/price/platform/account/region/service conditions; audio identity/provenance/rights; exact event identity; and reuse clearance.
The report now says the creator claims attendance at a JD Cloud conference while visuals establish only a JD/JD Cloud-related event context.

gateSummary.rationale: All seven count-based gates meet their thresholds and the independent meta-audit finds no unguarded closure. This is an evaluation result, not a workflow READY declaration.

judgeRationale.readability: The report leads with the cognitive change, then separates capabilities, cases, claims, absences, audio, reuse, and retained conclusions in a clear hierarchy.
judgeRationale.knowledgePrioritization: Consequential claims and their limits appear before supporting detail; numerical, identity, causality, and licensing risks are not buried.
judgeRationale.evidenceUsefulness: Cue, targeted-frame, OCR, and audio-source references are specific and preserve the distinction between source evidence and machine candidates.
judgeRationale.executionValue: The bounded reuse disposition and eight-condition clearance checklist turn uncertainty into a concrete downstream decision rule.
judgeRationale.compressionWithoutLoss: The report is thorough and loses no material audit finding, but its 83-second source is reconstructed at substantial length, leaving modest room for tighter phrasing.

metaAudit.rationale: Independent closure audit checked transcript, burned text/OCR, footage, motion sequences, edit/segmentation, layout/UI, full source audio, scoped absences, and reuse/rights. It also checked the opening-to-closing decision loop, author-label versus visible event context, claim-versus-example relations, SRT-versus-burned-text conflict, technical-shot versus semantic continuity, audio-to-closing relation, and rights/provenance-to-reuse disposition. No available carrier, consequential meaning change, or relationship remains unguarded. Candidate metaGate.pass=false is correctly treated as non-authoritative self-audit discipline and does not substitute for this independent meta-audit.

examples.finding: CUE-017 preserves the supplied SRT wording while TARGET-0054 and OCR-00403 support the burned-caption reading 高商业可用数字人; the reconstruction does not silently rewrite the transcript.
The two-person and motion sequences support co-presence and fashion-display observations, not real/digital identity, realtime interaction, or proof that the digital participant performs the walk.

The current run processes the full 0-83.220313-second mix, repairs the 48.66-53.48-second ASR miss with a targeted model pass, identifies persistent music and a closing transient only as bounded classifier-supported candidates, and retains provenance and rights unknowns.

The reconstruction permits reuse of abstract editorial functions only and requires traceable provenance, scoped rights, releases, brand/UI clearance, written case approval, dated substantiation, current-price verification, and audio licensing before direct reuse.
